PCCA-CAPOL-003.question: When must an insurer personally deliver a California homeowners nonrenewal notice?
PCCA-CAPOL-003.explanation: Insurance Code section 678(c) requires notice at least 75 days before expiration. A mailed notice must also allow the extra time specified by Code of Civil Procedure section 1013(a). The 45-day period for a renewal offer is a different rule.

PC-LIA-021.question: Which feature distinguishes a commercial umbrella from an excess policy that follows the underlying form?
PC-LIA-021.optionA: Lower deductibles on the underlying policy
PC-LIA-021.optionB: Coverage for some losses outside the underlying form
PC-LIA-021.optionC: Reinstatement of the underlying aggregate limit
PC-LIA-021.optionD: Payment of claims below the underlying retention
PC-LIA-021.explanation: An umbrella adds limits and may cover a loss excluded by the underlying form if the umbrella's own terms cover it. A self-insured retention may apply. A follow-form excess policy adds limits using the underlying coverage terms.
